description_excerpt: About the Role The Product Management role is responsible for driving the commercialization of assigned product portfolios by working closely with Sales teams and Clients. This role ensures effective marketing planning, pricing strategy, and sales enablement to achieve business growth and profitability targets. What You Will Deliver Product & Portfolio Management • Manage assigned product portfolio across lifecycle stages (launch, growth, optimization). • Develop product positioning, value proposition, and go-to-market strategies. • Monitor product performance (sales, margin, market share)…
